Talent.Explanation: "You have learned the Lore of Dark Magic, the forbidden magic of the Dark Elf sorceresses."

Sort.Explanation: "The sorceress rips a hole through the Aethyr, tearing through reality to make two locations overlap. The distance between portals is both infinitely wide and nothing at all, and all who pass through the door emerge instantly at the other location (though they may feel that the journey took some time). If the Spell is Miscast, do not roll on the table. Instead, the door closest to the caster connects to a random place in the Realm of Chaos and a Lesser Daemon creeps out, as per the Manifest Lesser Daemon Spell."

"The sorceress tears the veil between reality and the Aethyr, and a black cloud of roiling energy sweeps across the land, trailing slimy tentacles that drag unfortunate victims to an unknown fate. All who fall within the Area of Effect must make a Difficult (-10) Strength Test or suffer 3 Wounds. Those who Fumble the Strength Test must spend a Fate Point or be dragged into the Aethyr, which costs them their lives. The vortex moves 1d10 + 5 yards in a random direction each subsequent Round. Use the random vortex rules from Winds of Magic (pages 20-21) if available, or determine the direction randomly as you see fit."

"Screaming a plea to the Mistress of a Thousand Cuts, the sorceress scours their enemies with sweeping swords of crystallised Dhar. All targets within the Area of Effect are hit with a magic missile for Damage equal to her Willpower Bonus + 4 and must pass a Difficult (-10) Melee Test to prevent the Damage from ignoring armour."

"Calling upon the coldness of Nagaelythe of the Utterdark, the sorceress lashes the world with wind and bone-hollowing cold. This wind is a magic missile with Damage +8 that ignores Armour Points. All targets within the Area of Effect must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or take a Fatigued condition once per round while the wind blows. Ballistic Skill Tests within the Area of Effect incur a -3 SL penalty."

"A dense cloud of violent and baleful black energies roils about one of the sorceress's hands. This is a magic missile with Damage +12. All non-magical armour on the struck Hit Location is ignored and destroyed."

"The sorceress shrouds herself in a cape of half-solid Dhar. Channelling Dhar is twice as effective (double SL generated) for as long as the cloak lasts. Touching the cloak counts as Minor Exposure to Corruption for anyone but the caster."

"The sorceress summons a throttling force to grip her foe. They are shaken violently, striking all around them as they convulse and struggle. Death Spasm behaves as a magic missile with Damage +4 that ignores armour. Damaged targets immediately attack everyone within 1 yard of them with the weapon in their primary hand. Use the target's unmodified Weapon Skill when resolving such attacks, and they may not benefit from any Traits or Talents when making attacks."

"The sorceress opens tiny rents in reality, allowing malicious entities to whisper in the target's ears, urging paranoia, a sense of betrayal, or despair. Roll three times on the Mental Corruption Table and apply the results for 1d10 hours."

"Whispering a petition to Tyrannous Lamekh of the Third Hell, the sorceress takes control of her targets' bodies. Unless the sorceress lets them, Characters who begin their turn within the Area of Effect must pass a Very Hard (-30) Cool Test to Walk, Run, take a Melee Test, Ranged Test, or Casting Test."

"The sorceress invokes the name of an otherworldly beast and unleashes its blasphemous energy as a bolt of pure darkness. This is a magic missile with Damage +8, increased by +4 if the caster passes an optional Challenging (+0) Lore (Magic) Test immediately after the Casting Test. Failure in this additional Test causes a roll on the Major Miscast Table."

"The sorceress suffuses her target with hair-thin tendrils of malefic Dhar, making them a living marionette as dark energy braids through their muscles, bones, and nervous system. The sorceress's victim incurs a number of Entangled Conditions equal to her Intelligence Bonus minus the target's Strength Bonus. If this number is 0 or less, the Spell fails. The victim can Test to remove each Entangled Condition at the start of their Turn, Opposing the sorceress's Willpower with their Strength or Willpower. If they have at least one Entangled Condition, the sorceress can move their body as she wishes, although any physical Tests are taken at -2 SL."

"The sorceress's hand becomes insubstantial as it passes through the target's head and steals cherished memories and abilities, leaving confusion and emptiness. The target must pass a Difficult (-10) Cool Test. For every SL of failure, remove one Talent or reduce one Skill to the Characteristic baseline, chosen at random. The GM should also describe what parts of a Character's life they can no longer remember. The sorceress may add the stolen Skill or Talent to those available to her at the current level of her Career. An NPC supreme sorceress can add any stolen Talent or Skill to her profile immediately."

"The sorceress sends invisible entities to fasten themselves to a target's soul like parasitic worms. The target cannot sleep without suffering visions of terror, eroding their sanity over time. Each morning they awake with a Fatigued Condition, as well as an additional -15 to WP and Fel. They must also test for exposure to Minor Corruption. Before sleeping, they can attempt a Difficult (-10) Cool Test to shake the effect."

"The sorceress breathes sweet whispers of Dhar into a victim, twisting their minds to her own ends. Choose one target: For Fellowship Bonus Rounds, every Character within Willpower Bonus yards of the target gains a Psychology Trait related to that Character whilst they remain near (such as Hatred or Fear). Or, the target gains any one Psychology Trait for Fellowship Bonus Rounds. Characters can resist Poisoned Whispers' effects with an Opposed Cool Test vs the sorceress. Poisoned Whispers lasts until the affected Character passes a Difficult (-10) Cool Test, taken once per day at sunrise."

"The sorceress draws the fierce energies of the Realm of Chaos to empower herself and her allies. The caster and all allies within the Area of Effect gain +10 Strength and +10 Initiative for the Spell's duration. The sorceress also benefits from +2 SL to any Channelling (Dhar) Test made for the Spell's duration. Once the Spell ends, all affected must Test for Minor Corruption."

"The sorceress gestures with elaborate movements to bring a pall of gloom to engulf her enemies. Suffocating darkness suffuses all targets within the Area of Effect, sapping their will and energy. They suffer from 1 Fatigued Condition for every SL from the Casting Test and unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test, gain a Broken Condition."

"Seeding the atmosphere with Dhar to infect the open skies, the sorceress masters the heavens. They may banish clouds, summon hail, call up gale-force winds, or whatever they please. If using the weather table from Sea of Claws (page 106), she can choose any combination of weather conditions and wind."

"Pure, solidified darkness writhes from the caster's hands, drawing the essence from their hapless enemies to renew their own vigour. Soul Stealer acts as a magic missile with Damage +0 that ignores TB and AP. For every 2 Wounds dealt, the target loses 1 maximum Wound and the caster regains 1 Wound and 1 maximum Wound."

"The sorceress forces the air from her enemy's lungs, using their suffocating fear to syphon the breath from their allies too. Treat Stricken Voices as a magic missile with +0 Damage that ignores armour. The target, and up to Willpower Bonus Characters of the sorceress's choosing within Willpower Bonus yards of the target, begin Suffocating (WFRP Core Rulebook) until they pass a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test made at the start of their subsequent Turns."

"The sorceress masks her soul with the essence of her target's and masks her target's soul with her own. Should the target fail a Very Hard (-30) Cool Test, the two share a sense of self. The affected parties share all Psychology Traits and must pass a Difficult (-10) Cool Test to cause each other harm. The sorceress has access to all the target's memories and knowledge for the duration of the Spell."

"The sorceress subtly erodes the target's resolve and sense of purpose. As Dhar seeps into their mind, they lose their will and become susceptible to hostile influence. The target incurs a -4 SL penalty to any Willpower Test for the spell's duration. Sorceresses often use Unravelling Will to reduce a target's resistance to other Spells."

"Summoning a howling whirlwind, the sorceress is blown across the land, coming to rest with graceful ease as the magical tumult subsides. The billowing wind buffets any creatures or Characters of Size Average or smaller within Willpower Bonus yards of where the sorceress begins and ends her flight. Affected creatures or Characters must pass a Challenging (+0) Athletics Test or gain a Prone Condition."

"The sorceress blights the victim with an aura that repels companionship and fellow feeling. They become a pariah, feeling unloved, unwanted, or shunned, and even their friends recoil at their presence. The target incurs a -5 SL penalty to any Fellowship Test. Each hour, they can attempt a Hard (-20) Cool Test to stop the Spell's effects."

"As the sorceress utters a forbidden name, the bodies of her enemies bend and buckle, wracked with waves of agony. Targets within the Area of Effect must pass their choice of a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test or Difficult (-10) Cool Test, subtracting any SL from the Casting Test from the result. If they fail, all Tests they make are reduced by the same SL (to a minimum of 1 SL)."
